about: Centerline of the learning-loop sculpture as a closed, uniform Catmull-Rom spline in image UV (x right, y down). Figure-8 order: s=0 is the top of the upper loop. z marks the crossing: +1 is the glass strand in front, -1 the ceramic strand behind it. Traced by hand from design/assets/learning-loop.png; both scripts/sculpture-maps.mjs and the runtime read it.
